name: unsafe fn from_raw_parts (ptr : * mut T , length : usize , capacity : usize) -> Self
rule: For safety, `ptr` need not originate from a `Vec<T>` allocation, provided it was allocated using the global allocator, its allocation alignment equals the alignment of `T`, its allocation size in bytes equals `size_of::<T>() * capacity`, `length <= capacity`, its first `length` values are properly initialized values of type `T`, `capacity` is the capacity with which it was allocated, its allocated size is no larger than `isize::MAX` bytes, and nothing else uses `ptr` after the call.
api: impl < T > alloc::vec::Vec < T > { unsafe fn from_raw_parts (ptr : * mut T , length : usize , capacity : usize) -> Self }
expression: No complete expression is representable in this DSL: it cannot observe uses after the call or the typed validity of each of the first $2 pointee elements.
